user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: 1950s Retro Diner. A classic 1950s diner interior: checkered floor, red vinyl booths with chrome-edged tables, a long counter with swivel stools, a glowing jukebox, a milkshake and burger plate on the counter, ceiling fans spinning slowly, a pie display case, and neon signage in the window casting pink and cyan light across the chrome. Style: retro americana. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
